name: High Plank
steps: Plant your hands beneath your shoulders and step your feet back until your legs are straight and your toes support you.
Push gently away from the floor to protract your shoulder blades slightly, and brace your abs and glutes tightly.
Keep your body in a straight, rigid line from the top of your head down to your heels.
Hold this position steadily while breathing evenly for the target duration, then lower your knees gently to finish.
tips: Do not let your hips sag toward the floor or pike upward toward the ceiling.
Keep your gaze directed at the floor just in front of your hands so your neck stays neutral.
